method: All non-GROUNDED claims from EVERY candidate in the study pooled into ONE blind, shuffled call with a pinned rubric and worked examples, so a single DISTORTED/FABRICATED boundary applies study-wide. Re-run three times as candidates were added (4, then 5, then 8): every previously-adjudicated label was reproduced exactly each time. Single-candidate passes systematically OVER-call fabrication on weak models; the pooled boundary reclassifies most of it as DISTORTED (a real referent, wrongly stated). Pool text withheld; regenerate with tools/adjudicate.py.
